EverSales

    The Growth Ecosystem for SMBs. We install the sales infrastructure, talent, and systems needed to scale revenue predictably.

Core Value Proposition

EverSales transitions businesses from "Friction" (chaotic, manual selling) to "Flow" (predictable, automated systems). We don't just advise; we install the engine.

Service Tracks

    Start-up Sales Accelerator: Designed for Seed to Series A founders acting as the primary salesperson. Focuses on "Founder Magic Extraction" and hiring the first sales rep in 90 days.

Corporate Training: For established teams missing quotas or suffering from inconsistent performance. Includes call audits, script re-architecture, and live roleplay coaching.

The 4-Phase Installation Methodology

    Diagnostic Audit: Analyzing CRM data and call recordings to identify friction points.

Custom Blueprint: Building missing assets, including Sales Playbooks, word-for-word scripts, and email sequences.

Active Installation: Live workshops and roleplay sessions to install new behaviors and recruiting support.

System Handoff: Installing management KPIs and dashboards for automated operation.

Educational Events

    Live Workshops: 1-day intensive skill sessions.

Training Bootcamps: Multi-day immersive programs.

Webinars: Free 60-minute strategy sessions.

Target Outcomes

    Velocity: Average 3.5x increase in pipeline velocity.

    Accuracy: 100% CRM data accuracy.

    Scale: Transitioning from founder-led sales to managed team operations.
